verdict.rationale: Trello documents visual progress tracking of work items on boards, and a community user describes status columns (Idea => Doing => Done), so status tracking is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows priority fields or team ownership of items. Card badges are a Power-Up developer building block and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented priority attribute, owning-team assignment, initiative-level (rather than task-level) tracking, and independent corroboration of these.
